mentions.name: Koaches
mentions.description: An interview coaching and preparation platform that helps candidates prepare for behavioral interviews, including story creation, mock interview practice, and interview-specific practice, starting with behavioral interviews before expanding to other interview types.
mentions.problem: Providing one-on-one interview coaching alongside a full-time job limited availability to about one person at a time, or 5-10 people per year, due to logistics, interview cycles, and family constraints.
mentions.audience: Job candidates preparing for behavioral interviews, particularly anyone actively interviewing
mentions.source_excerpt: So I took my 10 years of coaching expertise and turned it into https://koaches.app/ which is an interview coaching and preparation platform that helps candidate prepare for their behavioral interviews which includes stories creation, mock interview practice and interview specific practice.
